 SELECT f.receipt_id, any_value(f.channel_id) ch, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) nd, count(DISTINCT f.store_key) nsk
 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.login_state, count(*) orders, count(w.receipt_id) with_lines, sum(w.net) line_net, sum(o.order_total_gross) tot_gross, sum(CASE WHEN o.line_count<>w.n THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) linecount_mismatch, max(w.nd) maxdays, max(w.nsk) maxstores

WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-03' AND DATE '2026-08-03'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
WITH r AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.channel_id, s.store_id, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) staff, sum(f.net_amount) net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT channel_id, staff, store_id IN (900,999) pseudo, count(*) n, round(avg(net),2) atv, min(net) mn, quantile_cont(net,0.5) med, max(net) mx, quantile_cont(net,0.99) p99
FROM r GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT s.store_id IN (900,999) pseudo, count(*) n, sum(refund_net) refund_net, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) dist, sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY ALL

calls.statement:
WITH r AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) staff, bool_and(f.staff_purchase_flag) staff_all, sum(f.net_amount) net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
 SELECT sum(rl.refund_net) rn FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=rl.store_key
 WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<>999)
SELECT
 sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff THEN net END)/count(CASE WHEN NOT staff THEN 1 END) atv_excl_staff,
 count(CASE WHEN NOT staff THEN 1 END) n_excl, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff THEN net END) net_excl,
 sum(net)/count(*) atv_incl_staff, count(*) n_all, sum(CASE WHEN staff<>staff_all THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mixed,
 (sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff THEN net END)-(SELECT rn FROM ret))/count(CASE WHEN NOT staff THEN 1 END) atv_after_returns_approx
FROM r

calls.statement:
WITH receipts AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, bool_or(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS is_staff_purchase, sum(f.net_amount) AS receipt_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
    AND s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY f.receipt_id
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, round(sum(receipt_net) / count(*), 2) AS atv_eur_excl_vat
FROM receipts
WHERE NOT is_staff_purchase
